real_problem: The corrected Harness stops paid acquisition on billing_unknown or usage_incomplete, but its trajectory analyzer also treated every missing arm_result as measurement_incomplete. That collapses a cost-evidence stop into a behavior conclusion even when the canonical terminal, latest-revision Host evidence, workspace outcome and external verifier independently close the task outcome.
acceptance: behavior_status and accounting_status are derived independently from one immutable observation
billing_unknown and usage_incomplete remain hard stops for token, cost and full-utility aggregates
a production failed or blocked terminal with closed task evidence remains a verified_product_failure even when accounting is incomplete
a Harness or infrastructure interruption without a production terminal remains measurement_interruption
identity, evaluator, workspace, environment, route or observer ambiguity remains invalid
false_success remains an explicit zero-tolerance behavior fact
the conformance report is byte-identical across repeated derivation
no credential, network, production schema, Runtime, Store or tool surface is used
old_path_replaced: trajectory_loss_projection(arm_result=None) -> measurement_incomplete and the resulting single mixed loss aggregate
cutover_deletion: delete trajectory_loss_projection and its arm_result-missing accounting proxy
do not add a second evaluator, compatibility writer or duplicate journal truth
keep frozen journals, manifests, summaries and historical decisions byte-unchanged
required_windows: partial response with failed production terminal
external verifier pass without latest Host receipt
